d: India’s battle over voter rolls has moved firmly onto the streets. Opposition parties led by Rahul Gandhi held a major rally in Delhi demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, an end to the Special Intensive Revision process and accountability over what they describe as a flawed voter-roll exercise. The ruling BJP held a counter-protest, demanding an apology from the Congress over the 1984 anti-Sikh riots and accusing the opposition of deliberately holding its rally around the riots’ anniversary.
